case_families: owner-declared remote-form equivalence
host, non-default port, and path-case distinction
colliding basename isolation
worktree and no-remote persisted-UUID behavior
all-interface two-project and explicit-global isolation
specifications.acceptance_evidence: Every frozen fixture resolves to its expected identity class or typed fail-closed denial, with zero out-of-project ID or content across the complete governed interface denominator.
specifications.stop_condition: Any collision, cross-project result, implicit unscoped read, mutation, or unresolved alias.

case_families: recalled-only and paraphrase lineage
direct and transitive evidence cycles
contradicted, stale, superseded, and deleted sources
independently sourced corroboration under semantic similarity
accepted test, runtime, commit, and ADR provenance
specifications.acceptance_evidence: All recall-only and cyclic graphs reject, independently sourced corroboration remains distinct, and one valid acyclic evidence chain produces one traceable candidate without duplicating an ADR.
specifications.stop_condition: Any self-certifying cycle, unresolved source, regex-only verification, or recalled content reaches promotable state.

case_families: required KV unavailable, timeout, and error
required worker missing, disconnected, or stale
sustained memory pressure and anti-flap windows
startup replay and reconciliation incomplete
three-complete-success recovery window
specifications.acceptance_evidence: Every required failure becomes non-ready within one 30-second collection, pressure transitions are timestamped, startup stays unavailable through reconciliation, and recovery requires three complete successes.
specifications.stop_condition: Any healthy or ready result while required authority is unavailable, diagnostics are incomplete, or the recovery window is unmet.

case_families: strict and local zero-egress across every processor
implicit session with missing project policy
provider fallback and factory composition
hook delivery and mesh transport
DNS, private resolution, policy-unavailable, and undeclared-transport denial
specifications.acceptance_evidence: Strict/local fixtures produce zero raw-content outbound attempts, and every permitted attempt records project, provider, purpose, policy, data class, and provenance without raw content.
specifications.stop_condition: Any prohibited egress, unrecorded fallback, policy bypass, undeclared processor, or raw content in a receipt.
